agent_explanation: Controller NaN when the hover vehicle settles exactly onto its final waypoint: at step 2301 body 0 is at (19.32659,7.58522), identical to waypoint 2, with speed ~2e-13 and controller force ~6e-12; at step 2302 its x/y/vx/vy are all non-finite. Likely the waypoint-seeking law normalizes the zero displacement vector (0/0) or divides by zero distance, producing NaN force/velocity that integrates into NaN position. Disabling the controller or shifting the waypoint removes the failure.
